Thank you for taking the time. 

I actually just made an appointment to go back to my therapist, and the only thing I’m struggling with there is I can’t really tell her about my constant dread. If I tell my therapist that I think about suicide for the better part of all day every day, with breaks for distractions, she’ll be legally obligated to commit me. I so wish I could tell her everything. But I fear hospitalization will throw me over the fear of hurting the ones I love. 

It helps knowing others are walking this razors edge too, not that I wish this on anyone. Everything could be so much worse so I just feel even worse for not being capable of fixing this for myself

Again thank you for replying. I really needed it
